topic: water and power shortages, anti-government protests
quote1: The young protesters were euphoric when they were joined by soldiers from the Capsat military unit in October last year, a turning point in weeks of anti-government demonstrations.
quote2: Exactly one year ago, on October 12, 2025, Malagasy President Andry Rajoelina left power aboard a French military plane, following eighteen days of protests led by the youth.
